# GMaps Lead Finder — Google Maps Scraper Client

> Official open-source Python + TypeScript + Go + Rust + PHP + Ruby + .NET client for the GMaps Lead Finder hosted Agent API.
> Not a local browser scraper. Auth: Bearer gmf_… key. Env: GMF_API_KEY.
> Supports leads (keyword), reviews (single place), and photos (single place).

## Links

- Website: https://gmapsleadfinder.com
- Pricing: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/pricing
- Get API key: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/account#api-key
- HTTP API docs: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/docs/api
- Agent & MCP docs: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/docs/agent
- Agents hub: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/agents
- OpenAPI: https://gmapsleadfinder.com/openapi-agent.yaml
- Support: support@gmapsleadfinder.com
- Agent instructions in this repo: /AGENTS.md
- Human docs: /docs/getting-api-key.md, /docs/http-api.md, /docs/mcp.md, /docs/python.md, /docs/typescript.md, /go/README.md, /rust/README.md, /ruby/README.md, /dotnet/README.md
- PHP SDK (separate repo): https://github.com/google-maps-lead-scraper/google-maps-scraper-php

## API summary

- Base: https://gmapsleadfinder.com
- Auth header: Authorization: Bearer gmf_<key>
- GET /api/v1/me — plan & credits
- POST /api/v1/jobs — body {"keyword":"..."} (exactly one keyword)
- GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} — poll status
- GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/results?limit=&cursor= — paginated rows; follow nextCursor
- POST /api/v1/review-jobs — body {"place":"<url or business_id>"} (exactly one place)
- GET /api/v1/review-jobs/{id} — poll reviews status
- GET /api/v1/review-jobs/{id}/results?limit=&cursor= — paginated review rows
- POST /api/v1/photo-jobs — body {"place":"<url, business_id, or Place ID>"} (exactly one place)
- GET /api/v1/photo-jobs/{id} — poll photos status
- GET /api/v1/photo-jobs/{id}/results?limit=&cursor= — paginated photo rows
- POST /mcp — Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP); tools gmaps_me, gmaps_create_job, gmaps_get_job, gmaps_get_results, gmaps_create_reviews_job, gmaps_get_reviews_job, gmaps_get_reviews_results, gmaps_create_photos_job, gmaps_get_photos_job, gmaps_get_photos_results

## Limits

- Growth plan or higher required for Agent API/MCP
- One running job per user (HTTP 409 if busy)
- Exactly one keyword per leads job; exactly one place per reviews or photos job
- 1 credit = 1 place row
- Results limit 1–500 (default 100)

## SDK entrypoints

- Install Python: `pip install google-maps-scraper-sdk` (import `gmaps_scraper`)
- Install TypeScript: `npm install @gmapsleadfinder/google-maps-scraper`
- Install Go: inside a module, `go get github.com/google-maps-lead-scraper/google-maps-scraper/go@v0.1.2`
- Install Rust: `cargo add google-maps-scraper-sdk` (path `google_maps_scraper_sdk`)
- Install PHP: `composer require gmapsleadfinder/google-maps-scraper` (namespace `GmapsLeadFinder\GoogleMapsScraper`)
- Install Ruby: `gem install google-maps-scraper-sdk` (require `gmaps_scraper` → `GmapsScraper::Client`)
- Install .NET: `dotnet add package GmapsLeadFinder.GoogleMapsScraper` (namespace `GmapsLeadFinder.GoogleMapsScraper`)
- CLI tool: `dotnet tool install -g GmapsLeadFinder.GoogleMapsScraper.Cli`
- Source: `/python`, `/typescript`, `/go`, `/rust`, `/ruby`, `/dotnet`; PHP: https://github.com/google-maps-lead-scraper/google-maps-scraper-php
- Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/gmapsleadfinder/google-maps-scraper
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/google-maps-scraper-sdk
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/GmapsLeadFinder.GoogleMapsScraper
- High-level helpers: scrape/Scrape/ScrapeAsync (leads); scrape_reviews/scrapeReviews/ScrapeReviews/ScrapeReviewsAsync; scrape_photos/scrapePhotos/ScrapePhotos/ScrapePhotosAsync
- Maintainer publish guide: /docs/publishing.md
